structs.name: SvServerInitSettings

Nothing is copied from 220. Game-test has 224 with loadScripts at 220; see changed_members.

No Replay access at 208 in any struct-taking function (UNCONFIRMED removal)
gt 210 -> possibly 208 (1 byte) if the -2 shift starts at 208
gt 214/216/218/219/220 -> 212/214/216/217/218 (-2 shift carried on from isFrontEnd)

structs.notes: Rule-of-thumb shift: the -2 starts between 192 and 209 and is seen again at 209 (isSaveGame, gt 211), 211 (isFrontEnd, gt 213), 213 (registerDvars, gt 215) and 215 (serverThreadStartup, gt 217). Coordinator should check the 2 bytes at 208 with a second opinion before applying, since the weapon field and isMapPreloaded cannot be told apart from Replay code. The copy length says the struct is 220 bytes; the IDA 224 is wrong.
